editorNote: Summer's slate is overflowing, so this month we sort it by your tastes: a returning isekai titan, a cyberpunk landmark reborn, a quiet horror that gets under your skin, and a comedy with a surprisingly warm heart — plus what's making noise across the fandom. Watch what fits you, skip the rest.

stories.headline: Summer 2026 is one of the most stacked anime seasons in years
stories.summary: The season is overflowing: long-running heavyweights like Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War continue, Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha returns to TV after decades away, and a wave of new adaptations lands alongside them. If you'd sooner watch by your taste than scroll a 50-title grid, that's what this issue is for.
stories.whyItMatters: With more airing than anyone can keep up with, curation beats a raw lineup — the picks below sort the season by theme.

sourceLinks.title: Most anticipated of Summer 2026 (Anime News Network)

stories.headline: Isekai & fantasy: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 is the season's most-hyped return
stories.summary: Fans in Japan and abroad agree Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 is the summer's most anticipated title — the continuation of the isekai that helped define the modern genre. If sweeping fantasy world-building is your thing, this is the season's centerpiece.
stories.whyItMatters: For the isekai & fantasy theme, it's the safest bet of the season — a flagship continuation rather than an untested premise.

sourceLinks.title: Japan crowns Mushoku Tensei the best summer 2026 anime (Game Rant)

stories.headline: Cyberpunk & sci-fi: Science SARU reimagines Ghost in the Shell
stories.summary: Science SARU's The Ghost in the Shell follows Major Motoko Kusanagi and Section 9 through complex cybercrimes in a neon future, blending Masamune Shirow's original style with the studio's animation — and the mystery, action, and psychological horror of having your own mind hacked.
stories.whyItMatters: For the cyberpunk & sci-fi theme, it's a landmark franchise rebuilt by one of today's most distinctive studios.

sourceLinks.title: The Ghost in the Shell — Summer 2026 Preview Guide (ANN)

stories.headline: Psychological: The Summer Hikaru Died is the quiet horror to watch
stories.summary: A slow-burn psychological thriller with a horror undercurrent, The Summer Hikaru Died turns a small-town friendship into a study of identity, vulnerability, and superstition — unsettling without leaning on jump scares.
stories.whyItMatters: For the psychological-thrillers theme, it's the season's most talked-about mood piece — tension over spectacle.

stories.headline: Cozy & wholesome: 100 Girlfriends has a surprisingly warm heart
stories.summary: Behind a deliberately absurd premise — a boy fated to love a hundred girlfriends — The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You skips toxic rivalry for a supportive, almost family-like dynamic, anchoring its wild comedy with genuine warmth.
stories.whyItMatters: For the cozy & wholesome theme, it's a feel-good watch that's sweeter than its title suggests.

stories.headline: On the radar: five summer shows with breakout potential
stories.summary: Beyond the sure things, a handful of summer titles are being tipped as possible hits of the year — worth a slot in your queue if you like getting in early on something before it blows up.
stories.whyItMatters: A watchlist for next month: today's sleeper is often next season's conversation.
